register.legal:
As data controller, AIXAM MEGA collects your personal data for the purposes of, in particular, the administrative management of registrations to the event, the identification of Participants and the verification of the Participant’s e-mail address, the creation of access to the SKIN EASY design tool and the sending of the created visual in digital format, fraud prevention, possibly contacting Participants whose creations have been shortlisted for study as part of future product developments, and producing anonymised statistics about the event. Your data is intended for the administrative and support departments of AIXAM MEGA. Data marked with an asterisk (*) is mandatory.
In accordance with the amended French Data Protection Act no. 78-17 of 6 January 1978 and the General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 April 2016 (GDPR), you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict and object to the processing of your data. You can exercise your rights by e-mailing dpo@xx.fr or by post to AIXAM MEGA, (56 ROUTE DE PUGNY, 73100 AIX-LES-BAINS). For more information about the processing of your personal data, you can read our policy by {politique}.
To read the contest rules, {reglement}.
